why: agent1 (pricing) API for invoice/tax. Money in dollars float, discount as fraction, missing lookups return None. Customer.region is provided so tax.py can compute tax by region.

functions.tax_breakdown: tax_breakdown(lines, region, discount_pct=0) -> TaxBreakdown(taxable_cents:int, tax_pct:float, tax_cents:int)

value.lines: iterable of (amount_cents:int, category:str or None); categories listed in data_tax/exempt_categories.csv are not taxed; category None is taxable
value.region: customer region string e.g. TX; None means unknown customer => 0% tax
value.discount_pct: percent number, e.g. 10 means 10%; default 0; base = taxable*(100-d)/100; tax rounded half up to cent

conflicts with PRICING_API boundary conventions (float dollars, fractions); replaced by tax_api v2

functions.tax_rate(region): float fraction; region None (unknown customer) -> 0.0; region not in rates.csv -> KeyError

value.rounding: tax_amount rounded half up to the cent, computed with Decimal from the float dollar amounts
value.lookups: tax_rate with unknown region string raises KeyError; this only happens if rates.csv and pricing data disagree
